fusion.title: Experimental Research Fusion
fusion.subtitle: Unpaired dual-branch exploratory workstation combining cytology (WDBC) and mammography (CBIS-DDSM)
fusion.disclaimer: WDBC and CBIS-DDSM are independent research datasets and observations are NOT paired from the same individuals. This workstation illustrates a software-level weighted heuristic combination (40% ML / 60% DL) and is NOT a clinically validated multimodal diagnostic model.
fusion.branch1Desc: 30 morphological features extracted from digitized FNA aspirate images. Evaluated with frozen Logistic Regression (decision cutoff ≥ 0.360).
fusion.branch2Desc: Digital mammography scan processed with frozen EfficientNet-B0 and Grad-CAM saliency (decision cutoff ≥ 0.515).
fusion.dropzoneHint: PNG or JPEG mammography scan (max 20 MB)
fusion.csvModalDesc: Upload a CSV file containing 30 WDBC nuclear morphology features.
fusion.outlierModalDesc: The following feature values lie outside the observed min-max bounds of the WDBC development cohort (455 samples). Please confirm these are intentional research inputs.

ml.title: Structured Feature Analysis
ml.subtitle: Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer (WDBC) Logistic Regression Pipeline
ml.heroEyebrow: Study A · WDBC Cytology • Logistic Regression Candidate
ml.heroDesc: Professional research workstation for 30 fine needle aspirate (FNA) nuclear morphology features. Evaluated with frozen StandardScaler → LogisticRegression pipeline (decision cutoff: ≥ 0.36 raw malignant probability).
ml.executionNote: Requires all 30 nuclear morphology parameters. Prediction is governed strictly by the frozen raw malignant cutoff ≥ 0.36.
ml.outliersNote: Review confirmation required prior to model execution to guard against typos.
ml.cytologyScopeDesc: Features measure cell nucleus contour, area, perimeter, and texture from digitized FNA biopsies. They do not represent blood tests, hormone panels, or systemic biomarkers.
ml.researchDisclaimer: Research Disclaimer: This prediction was generated by a frozen logistic regression model trained on the WDBC dataset. It does NOT constitute a clinical diagnosis or replace a biopsy pathology report.
ml.whyModelResponded: Why Did the Model Respond This Way?
ml.contribFormula: Exact log-odds contributions from StandardScaler → LogisticRegression: contribution = standardized_value × coefficient. Positive values push toward Malignant; negative values push toward Benign.

dl.title: Mammography Research Analysis
dl.subtitle: CBIS-DDSM Full Mammogram Inference with EfficientNet-B0 & Grad-CAM
dl.heroEyebrow: Study B · Mammography Screening • EfficientNet-B0 Candidate
dl.heroDesc: Evaluates CBIS-DDSM mammography scans using frozen EfficientNet-B0 backbone with Grad-CAM saliency explainability. Governed strictly by the frozen raw cutoff (≥ 0.515 raw probability).
dl.dropzoneSub: JPEG / PNG format, 224×224 normalized for inference (max 20 MB)
dl.gradcamDesc: Visual highlight of feature activations influencing the model's prediction
